title: Nissan shuts down global vehicle diagnostics system after detecting unauthorized access, NYT reports
date_note: Start of the disruption as given by zn.ua (21 November 2026), relaying The New York Times; zn.ua says it was still unresolved on Friday, 20 November.
place: Japan (company's home country; dealers worldwide affected)
geo_basis: country: the article describes Nissan as a Japanese automaker; no site of the intrusion is stated
summary: Nissan suspended several connected functions of its CONSULT-III plus dealer diagnostic software after detecting unauthorized access to part of the system, according to cyberattaque.org and, relaying The New York Times, zn.ua. The disruption began on 13 November; cyberattaque.org says it continued on 23 November with no restoration date announced. It says ECU and key programming are affected and that Nissan says CONSULT-IV is not.
plain: Nissan switched off a worldwide system its dealers use to diagnose and reprogram cars after finding someone had got into it. Some repairs and spare keys for Nissan and Infiniti cars may be delayed.
exec: A dealer diagnostics system was taken offline after unauthorized access, delaying some Nissan and Infiniti repairs; a reminder that service tooling is attack surface.
impact: Dealers cannot reprogram vehicle electronics or make duplicate keys while the system is offline; routine maintenance continues, per Nissan's message to service centres as relayed by zn.ua. cyberattaque.org says no evidence shows vehicle software was modified and no customer data theft has been announced.

sources.name: zn.ua (relaying The New York Times): Кибератака на Nissan: автопроизводитель отключил глобальную систему диагностики
cyberattaque.org: Nissan victime d’une cyberattaque : des réparations automobiles bloquées depuis dix jours

key_findings: Nissan reported a temporary shutdown of its global vehicle diagnostics system after detecting unauthorized access.
The disruption began on 13 November and was still unresolved on 20 November.
Dealers cannot reprogram electronics or make duplicate keys; service for Nissan and Infiniti cars may be delayed.

evidence.quote: Сбой начался 13 ноября, и по состоянию на пятницу, 20 ноября, его еще не устранили.

validation.note: zn.ua (relaying The New York Times) and cyberattaque.org both state the unauthorized access and suspension; neither cites a Nissan page, so Nissan's statement is relayed, not read.

review.note: Compared title, 13 Nov start, unresolved 20 Nov, dealer limits, no attribution against zn.ua (quote found); single source, NYT not read
